interpretation: Q2 shadows remain soft in both models. Sony windows/edges are also soft without a clear overall winner. On these GFX50R concrete crops V43 shows sharper seams and more visible surface variation than RawNIND; without a clean reference this does not establish that every retained fluctuation is true detail. These few fixed contexts do not establish a broad real-photo or SOTA advantage.
